name: deploy-fanout-qa
description: Deployment-gate orchestration: when a deploy lands, judge-blast-radius scopes what to re-test, QA fans out across the affected components in parallel (map), and judge-release-readiness renders a ship/hold verdict — green records and proceeds, any red holds for a human. Read-only: it validates and decides, it does not edit code.

phases.name: scope
phases.description: What did this deploy touch, and how far do its effects reach? Determines re-test breadth.

phases.name: fan-out-qa
phases.description: Run QA across the affected components in parallel, capped to a pool of 3 (sims/test workers) via map concurrency. In production `over` would be ${scope.components}; this demo uses an inline component set so it runs out of the box.

body.name: qa-component
body.prompt: Run QA for the '${item}' component against the new build. You are the validator for this one component — exercise it with the tools you have (or do a static check and say so), then return a PASS/FAIL verdict with concrete evidence scoped to '${item}'. Do NOT try to load or hand off to a per-component skill/sub-suite — run the check yourself.
body.description: Validate component '${item}' against expected behavior on the new build (generic qa-runner; per-component agent path could be substituted via the interpolated `agent` field — e.g. agents/${item}-qa-suite.md — when such agents exist).

phases.name: readiness-gate
phases.description: Aggregate the QA results into a go/no-go verdict.

ship.name: record-green
ship.description: All green — record the readiness report; the deploy stands.

hold.name: hold-for-human
hold.description: A red/flaky/uncovered result — hold and let a human decide on rollback.
